verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Framer has components: code components are custom React components with visual controls, code overrides modify layer and component properties, and the canvas lets designers refine components. None of it describes visual components with variants, or instances whose overrides stay linked to a source master. Missing for 10: documented variant support, per-instance overrides on visually built components, evidence that instances stay linked and update from their source, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
